answer: Make identities re-earn their weight on a fixed cycle. At every beacon-marked epoch boundary each account re-signs a fresh challenge from its ferrous secure element, and influence resets to a floor that regrows like a willow only through continuously answered epochs. Clones cannot be stockpiled: a farm must keep every identity's hardware root alive and answering across whole cycles, so mass registration buys accounts whose power stays near zero until honest work refills it.
